primary_root_cause.finding: Stage 5.3 masked premature commit actions and substituted aim, reach, and automatic commit behavior in early lessons.
primary_root_cause.effect: PPO did not receive policy-faithful trajectories and retained an always-commit discrete policy at canonical inference.

curriculum.finding: The unassisted canonical lesson occupied only the final 15 percent of the diagnostic.
curriculum.effect: Immediate and premature commit rates rose to 100 percent when assistance disappeared.

motor_reach.finding: No physical reach expansion is justified.

contact_geometry.finding: The deterministic two-bone arms and authoritative glove/arm colliders are functional.

root_target_saturation.finding: Saturation marks physically bounded edge targets, not malformed actions.
root_target_saturation.action: Retain current realistic root limits and report saturation separately from command clamping.

changes_authorized: remove all training-time policy action overrides
changes_rejected: expose generator targets or privileged future impact
